scope: Native Linux transport tests on the x86_64 build host and cross-compiled AArch64 libraries
listener: SO_PEERCRED must report a positive PID and the namespace projection of UID 0, the systemd listener owner
memfd: The descriptor must retain all required seals and its owner must match the namespace projection of the resolved t736-cedar account

regressions.wrong_memfd_owner: EPROTO before mapping, disconnected, no backend calls

regressions.transport: actual client and broker: >1000 pulls, malformed replies, fd balance
regressions.fork: DONTFORK, PID gating, CLOEXEC, active parent socket retained
